mapper.sql: t.template_id, t.site_code, t.notify_type, t.platform, t.msg_format, t.content, t.enabled, t.version, t.remark, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time
mapper.select: select from monitor_notify_template t order by t.site_code nulls first, t.notify_type, t.platform

select from monitor_notify_template t where t.notify_type = #{notifyType} and t.platform = #{platform} and t.enabled = true and (t.site_code = #{siteCode} or t.site_code is null) order by case when t.site_code is null then 1 else 0 end limit 2
mapper.insert: insert into monitor_notify_template (site_code, notify_type, platform, msg_format, content, enabled, version, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{siteCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{notifyType}, #{platform}, #{msgFormat}, #{content}, #{enabled}, 1, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update monitor_notify_template set content = #{content}, enabled = #{enabled}, remark = #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where template_id = #{templateId}
